name: Class buffs: a crit cooldown stacks with another class's crit aura
contract: Maintainer decision 2026-11-22: area cooldowns must not skip a player who carries another class's
aura; a permanent aura and a cooldown stack. Slayer 300968 (Witch Hunter, family 21, passive raid area
aura, SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT base points 2: +3%) is in the crit aura category, spell_group 2113024.
Horn of War 800086 (Ranger, family 27, raid area aura for 30 seconds on a 60 second cooldown,
SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT base points 4: +5%) is in the timed crit category, spell_group 2113005. Slayer's
rule-3 group 2000181 does not hold Horn of War, so no shared group decides the pair. Expected: both
auras stay applied on a grouped ally and on the Ranger, and the Ranger's melee crit rises by 8. Crit is
measured on the Ranger because Horn of War's crit effect currently reaches only its caster: the direct
effect 1 application gives party members their own Horn of War aura, and the Ranger's area effect then
skips them in Aura::UpdateTargetMap. A fresh character's crit field reads 0 until a crit aura first
recomputes it, so Night Stalker 300792 primes the field first.
